baselineCapability: No migration command/module in baseline; existing prepared images required a new preparation to gain a delivery mapping.
scope: Bounded operator migration of one explicitly selected already-published application. Default offline dry-run verifies manifest/archive/image bytes. --publish uses existing private-repository/asset-digest checks, serial image publication and verified asset reuse. No rebuild, immutable-artifact rewrite, cache clearing, build quota changes, new user step or runtime/server change.
coverage: Offline dry-run performs no provider calls or artifact mutations.
Publication deduplicates shared service references, keeps immutable files identical and resolves via the existing delivery path.
Retry preserves a prior successful mapping and recovers a second completed upload whose response was lost, without duplicate uploads.
All selected image bytes are checked before remote publication. Changed manifest identity, mismatched image metadata, corrupted archive/image and conflicting archive references fail.
Symlink input and invalid application paths fail.
Bundle artifacts need no image migration; missing/private-repository configuration gates container publication.
CLI uses explicit app selection, defaults to dry-run, avoids accidental database creation and returns a fixed error without exposing a secret marker.
Existing launcher/provider/storage/browser/build checks remain passing on local and isolated Linux.

infrastructureRetry.firstAttempt: Final Linux archive transfer was rejected because the earlier staging filename could not be overwritten; no final-suite tests started.
infrastructureRetry.recovery: Same final candidate bytes copied under a new owned staging filename; source hashes independently verified in the isolated guest before the passing run.
